item.title: Maine clergy form spiritual ‘shield’ outside workplaces to protect immigrants from ICE
item.description: (RNS) — Like religious leaders in cities such as Minneapolis, Chicago and elsewhere, local clergy were quick to muster resistance to the rapid influx of immigration enforcement agents, even as they wrangle with the unusual geography of Maine.
